title: Robust Semis-Infinite Interval Equilibrium Problem Involving Data Uncertainty: Optimality Conditions and Duality
content: In this paper, we model uncertainty in both the objective function and the constraints for the robust semi-infinite interval equilibrium problem involving data uncertainty. We particularize these conditions for the robust semi-infinite mathematical programming problem with interval-valued functions by extending results from the literature. We introduce the dual robust version of the above problem, prove the Mond-Weir type weak and strong duality theorems, and illustrate with an example.
